messages:
Maya R: Hey team — heads up, my flight just got delayed and I won't make the start of my primary tonight. I need someone to cover 23:00-03:00 PT (I can do a partial handoff if needed). There's an active pager for hosted-api latency right now, so preferrably someone who can take the first chunk and run the initial mitigations.

IncidentBot: Pager triggered: hosted-api latency P2 - request_p99 > 2s in us-west-2 for 12m. Link: https://pager.redwood.internal/p/INC-4321. Escalation policy: oncall -> secondary -> eng-sre.

Samir: I can pick up 23:00-02:30 PT, but I have a hard standup at 01:30 PT so won't be available 01:30-01:50. Can Tess take 02:30-07:00?

Tess: I can cover 02:30-07:00. Need a quick summary of what's been done and the exact runbook steps for cache flush/rollout so I can pick up without fumbling.

Maya R: Thanks. Current mitigation summary (what's been done): 1) scaled runtime pool by +2 nodes 2) temporarily disabled route to model-A for low-latency tier 3) flushed shared prefix cache. Root cause still under investigation. I pinned the incident doc in #incidents and added notes. 

Maya R: Runbook snippet (copy/paste):
```
# quick checks for latency incident
kubectl get pods -n redwood-runtime -l svc=hosted-api
curl -sS https://internal-metrics/api/hosted-api/latency | jq '.p99'
# if tail latency > 3s: scale deployment
kubectl scale deploy/hosted-api -n redwood-runtime --replicas=6
# cache flush (safe): POST /internal/cache/flush?scope=prefix
```

Maya R: Also added INC-4321 link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4321. Customer impact: subset of hosted-api requests seeing p99 ~3.5s, error rate remains <0.5% so no mass degradation yet.

Vikram: I'm the secondary shadow for eu-west region tonight; I can handle escalation to P1 if it crosses region boundaries. Out between 00:00-01:00 PT, though.

Samir: OK I'll take 23:00-02:30 then hand off to Tess at 02:30. @oncall-bot can you record swap and notify #incidents? Also need the exact cache-flush curl command for the handoff note.

oncall-bot: Swap request received. New temporary rota recorded: Samir (primary) 23:00-02:30 PT, Tess (primary) 02:30-07:00 PT. Vikram added as secondary for EU/esc. Incident channel: #incidents-4321. Pager policy unchanged.

Tess: Please paste the exact curl lines and the quick checklist you'll run before handing off. I'll verify dashboards 5m prior to taking over.

Maya R: Pre-handoff checklist (what I'll do before leaving):
- confirm scaled replicas are healthy (kubectl describe pods -n redwood-runtime)
- confirm p99 trending down to <2s for 10m
- leave cache flush command exact: `curl -X POST "https://internal-api/cache/flush?scope=prefix" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
- post final incident note + handoff time in #incidents-4321

Samir: I'll run the pre-handoff checks 10 minutes before 23:00 and post status here. If error_rate > 0.5% or p99 > 3s I will keep holding and alert Vikram.

Tess: Got it, thanks. If anything spikes after 02:30 ping me and call Zoom (I can answer audio). Leaving my phone on for pager.

Maya R: Really appreciate you all covering. I'll DM my final ETA and add one-line notes to the incident doc before I head to the gate. Thanks :heart:
